statement: At the pinned kernel revision, hid-microsoft explicitly matches Xbox One model 1708 Bluetooth IDs 0x02fd and 0x0b20 via separate HID Bluetooth entries, as distinct from Xbox Series model 1914 ID 0x0b13. The driver attaches its main-motor force-feedback implementation to matched HID input; whether a particular physical firmware or host uses either path is untested.

applicability.revision: Xbox One S model 1708 Bluetooth consumers, excluding original wired-only baseline and Xbox Series
applicability.scope: hid-ids.h:1052-1060; hid-microsoft.c:281-347,427-435. The HID bus is different from xpad's wired USB driver.
